description: This file defines a PHP class `Log` within the `Opencart\Admin\Controller\Tool` namespace. The class extends a base Controller class and provides methods for viewing, downloading, and clearing log files related to the OpenCart administration tool section. It interacts with log files, handles file download headers, and manages session data, permissions, and rendering views.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Controller class for managing system logs in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the log listing page, including breadcrumb setup and error handling.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Handles downloading a specific log file, setting appropriate headers for file transfer.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears or resets the log file contents, preparing it for new log entries.
